items.title: 23.1 Drug discovery and development process (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 23.1 (PDF 208), with an original drug pipeline diagram.

blocks.text: Pharmacology biology ki woh shaakh hai jo dawaon (drugs) aur jandaron par un ke asraat ka mutala karti hai. Is mein dawaon ke zariye (sources), khasiyatein (properties), banawat (composition), ilaaj mein istemal (therapeutic uses) aur jism par un ke asraat parhe jate hain. Drugs woh kimiyai maadde (chemical substances) hain jo bimariyon ki tashkhees (diagnosis), bachao (prevention) ya ilaaj (treatment) ke liye istemal hote hain.

Dawaen qudrati zariyon, jaise paudon, janwaron aur microorganisms (khurdbeeni jandaron), se mil sakti hain, ya laboratories mein banayi (synthesize) ja sakti hain. Paudon se bani dawaen riwayati tareeqa-e-ilaaj mein aam istemal hoti hain aur herbal medicines (jari booti ki dawaen) ya phytotherapy kehlati hain.

Drug discovery (nayi dawa dhoondna) aur drug development (dawa ko tayyar karna) ahem amal hain jo bimariyon ke ilaaj ke liye mehfooz (safe) aur mo'assar (effective) dawaen banane mein madad dete hain. Yeh amal bimari paida karne wale targets ki pehchan se shuru hota hai, phir aise compounds banaye jate hain jo in targets par asar kar sakein. Awaam ke liye manzoori (approval) se pehle dawa kai marhalon ki testing se guzarti hai jis mein us ki hifazat (safety), asar (efficacy) aur miyaar (quality) jaanche jate hain. Scientists, researchers aur regulatory authorities (dawaon ki nigrani karne wale sarkari idare) is poore amal mein saath kaam karte hain taa ke nayi dawaen insanon ke liye faidamand aur mehfooz hon.

blocks.alt: Do hisson ka khaaka. Drug discovery: 1 Target identification, 2 Target validation, 3 Lead compound identification, 4 Lead optimization. Phir Drug development: 1 Preclinical research (in vitro aur in vivo), 2 Clinical trials (Phase 1: 20-100, Phase 2: 100-300, Phase 3: 1,000-3,000), 3 FDA drug review (approve or reject), 4 Manufacturing and marketing, 5 Post-marketing surveillance; har qadam ke darmiyan teer.
blocks.caption: Dawa ki daryaft (discovery) aur tayyari (development) ke qadam (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke qudrati (natural) aur masnooi (synthetic) zariye mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Qudrati dawaen paudon, janwaron ya microorganisms se milti hain; synthetic dawaen laboratories mein kimiyai tor par banayi jati hain.

items: Pharmacology: dawaon aur un ke asraat ka ilm; drugs bimari ki tashkhees, bachao ya ilaaj karti hain.
Dawaen qudrati (paude, janwar, microorganisms) ya synthetic; paudon wali dawaen herbal medicines (phytotherapy).
Discovery aur development: target ki pehchan se manzoori tak, safety, efficacy aur quality ki jaanch.
